verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say developers can access extracted data from government-issued ID documents and retrieve most verification details programmatically with a secret key. They explicitly name sensitive results such as date of birth, and the VerificationSession API shows results on completion, so the API returns more than a pass/fail flag. missing for 10: an explicit field-level list covering name, document number, address and expiry date, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the structured-data output.
